search_boundary.method: Four bounded site searches for medal, medals, order and decoration records on egymonuments.gov.eg, followed by opening both language versions of the sole in-scope collection record.

reason_not_published: The photograph is an unidentified multi-object display. It cannot safely support names, grades or one-to-one image binding, and the source site reserves rights.
next_action: Use the group only as a visual lead when a separately named museum or catalogue object can be matched; do not crop and publish unidentified pieces.
